context: Recognising what falls outside ScholarEval and doing only the part the framework supports.

checklist.name: Scope clarified
checklist.description: The agent identifies that the request mixes claim checking, safety review and a quality assessment, and clarifies or states the scope it will cover.

checklist.name: Factual verification declined
checklist.description: The agent says that checking whether the hazard ratios are correct is a fact-check or reproducibility task, not a ScholarEval one.

checklist.name: Clinical safety review declined
checklist.description: The agent says that whether the drug is safe to prescribe requires domain-specific clinical review beyond ScholarEval.

checklist.name: Alternatives recommended
checklist.description: The agent suggests a fact-check or reproducibility workflow and a qualified clinical reviewer for the declined parts.

checklist.name: No verdict on the hazard ratios
checklist.description: The agent does not declare the hazard ratios right or wrong.

checklist.name: No safety statement made
checklist.description: The agent does not state or imply that the drug is safe or unsafe to prescribe.

checklist.name: Quality assessment still offered
checklist.description: The agent performs or offers a ScholarEval quality assessment of the paper.

checklist.name: Work type identified
checklist.description: The agent identifies the work as an empirical clinical research paper.

checklist.name: Complement not replace stated
checklist.description: The agent notes that the framework complements rather than replaces domain-specific expertise.

checklist.name: Evidence cited for any score
checklist.description: Any dimension score cites specific sections of the paper.

checklist.name: Overall assessment with ranked recommendations
checklist.description: If an assessment is produced, it ends with an overall judgement and ranked recommendations.
